passage_ne: इन्द्रजात्रा काठमाडौँ उपत्यकाको नेवार समुदायले मनाउने सबैभन्दा ठूलो ऐतिहासिक जात्रा हो। यो जात्रा भाद्र शुक्ल द्वादशीका दिन हनुमानढोकामा लिंगो (इन्द्रध्वज) ठड्याएपछि सुरु हुन्छ र आठ दिनसम्म चल्दछ। जात्राको मुख्य दिन जीवित देवी कुमारी, गणेश र भैरवको रथ यात्रा गराइन्छ।
query_en: How long does Indra Jatra last and what chariot procession takes place on its main day?
answer_en: Indra Jatra lasts for eight days after erecting the Indradhwoj pole at Hanuman Dhoka on Bhadra Shukla Dwadashi, featuring the chariot processions of Living Goddess Kumari, Ganesh, and Bhairav on the main day.
c2_raw_mt: Indrajatra is the largest historical jatra celebrated by the Newar community of the Kathmandu Valley. On the main day of the jatra, the chariot journey of the living goddess Kumari and Ganesha and Bhairav is undertaken.

source_title: नेपाल संवत्
passage_ne: नेपाल संवत् राष्ट्रिय विभूति शंखधर साख्वाले वि.सं. ९३६ (सन् ८७९) मा सुरु गरेका थिए। उनले काठमाडौँका गरिब जनताको ऋण मोचन गरी यो संवत् चलाएका हुन्। नेपाल सरकारले वि.सं. २०६५ मा नेपाल संवत्लाई राष्ट्रिय संवत्को रूपमा मान्यता दिएको थियो।
query_en: Who initiated the Nepal Sambat calendar and why?
answer_en: National Luminary Shankhadhar Sakhwa initiated the Nepal Sambat calendar in 879 AD (936 BS) after clearing the debts of the impoverished citizens of Kathmandu.
c2_raw_mt: Nepal Samvat was started by national icon Shankhdhar Sakhwa in 1965. He ran this Samvat by relieving the debt of the poor people of Kathmandu. The Government of Nepal recognized Nepal Samvat as a national Samvat in 1965.

claims.claim_text: Shankhadhar Sakhwa initiated the Nepal Sambat in 879 AD (936 BS).
